text:
ivy: Heads-up: migrated one of our sample apps to a partner's custom bundler (mix of rollup + esbuild) and hit an edge-only regression: Authorization header gets duplicated after retry. Node dev + SSR fine.

ben: does it happen during build or at runtime?

ivy: runtime only. Under an edge preview (Cloudflare Pages / Netlify Edge) first request returns 401 as expected, the SDK retries and the header in the second request shows up duplicated (comma-separated). Example logs: 
```
[redwood] auth failed 401
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_TOKEN
Retrying...
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_TOKEN, Authorization: Bearer BAD_TOKEN
```

kara: Weve seen similar patterns with other bundlers. Which import form are you using? named or default?

ivy: Named ESM: `import { create } from '@redwood/inference'`. If I switch to the CJS path (`require('@redwood/inference/dist/cjs')`) the issue disappears. Also switching to the default ESM import (`import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`) sometimes masks it.

leo: That sounds like a packaging / interop difference combined with runtime fetch/Headers semantics. Bundlers can inline small helpers or polyfills that behave differently when mutated. Do you have repro steps?

ivy: Yes, minimal repro branch: 
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps -b custom-bundler-edge-repro
2) cd custom-bundler-edge
3) npm ci
4) REDWOOD_API_KEY=wrong npm run build:edge && npm run preview:edge
5) curl -v http://localhost:8787/api/complete

Handler is tiny: 
```ts
// src/api/complete.ts
import { create } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = create({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export async function post() {
  const r = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
  return new Response(await r.text());
}
```

toni: quick experiment: try patching the retry path to create a fresh Headers object before constructing the retry Request. e.g.: 
```js
// retry path (temporary local patch)
const safe = new Headers(origReq.headers || {});
safe.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${apiKey}`);
const retryReq = new Request(origReq, { headers: safe });
```
Ivy, did that?

ivy: patched that in node_modules locally & the duplication stopped under miniflare and the Cloudflare preview. But we need a permanent defensive change in the SDK.

ben: Agreed. We shouldn't depend on fetch cloning being consistent across runtimes. Also, bundler minification sometimes makes the bug intermittent (Ivy noticed it becomes nondeterministic when terser/minify=true). That suggests minifier changes helper layout/closures and exposes shared-state from inlined helpers.

kara: There's another related DX issue: TS language server in consumers fails to resolve typings/overloads when importing the ESM entry in some bundlers. VSCode shows no overload for create() unless the consumer imports the CJS path. That indicates our package.json exports and types fields are not wired for ESM consumers.

leo: Packaging note: ensure package.json exports contains both import/require entries and that types are reachable from the import path. Example: 
"exports": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"  (but tests needed because bundlers/tsserver vary).

toni: Action items proposed: 
- ivy: push the repro branch w/ exact bundler config and note about terser (ETA today).
- ben: PR to always create a fresh Headers object in the retry path and add a unit test simulating a worker-fetch clone (ETA tomorrow).
- kara: PR to adjust package.json exports+types and add a tiny `tsc --noEmit` CI job that compiles a minimal ESM consumer project (ETA EOD).
- leo: add CI matrix job that builds sample-apps with vite/rollup/webpack/parcel (with and without minify) and runs the bundles under our worker shims (miniflare / cloudflare preview) to catch bundler/minifier differences (ETA 2 days).

ivy: I'll include exact repro commands and the minimal rollup + esbuild plugin config I used. Also noted that switching to default import sometimes prevents the duplication which might help isolate whether the interop wrapper (named vs default binding) contributes.

ben: Quick test note: besides cloning headers, also avoid mutating built-in Headers objects anywhere. Prefer constructing from plain objects when building a Request for retry.

kara: For the types fix, we may need to emit an index.d.ts at both dist/esm and dist/cjs entrypoints or use the new conditional exports with a nested types field: e.g. "exports": { ".": { "import": { "types": "./dist/esm/index.d.ts", "default": "./dist/esm/index.js" }, "require": { "types": "./dist/cjs/index.d.ts", "default": "./dist/cjs/index.js" } } } — test against tsc & tsserver.

toni: I'll queue a CI job now to run the preliminary repro under miniflare. build-bot, can you run matrix?

build-bot: queued job devex/custom-bundler-edge-repro (#1157)  matrix: cloudflare/workers-v8, netlify-v8, wrangler-miniflare.

ivy: One more observation: when I import the CJS path during build the SDK is ~10kb smaller in the final bundle, which is another reason some users import CJS directly. But that shouldn't be required. Packaging + typing parity is important.

ben: Ok. Once PR to clone headers lands and CI matrix passes we'll consider a patch release. Kara, sync with release notes to mention header-clone fix + types/export parity fix.

ivy: Pushed the repro branch and README link in the GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/489. Will post PR links here when open. Thanks all. :rocket:
